# Dugas JAFZA Substation

> Dugas Substation is a 132/11 kV primary electricity substation in the northern part of the Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai. It steps high-voltage transmission supply down to eleven kilovolts for distribution to the industrial plots, warehousing and port-related facilities around it. Substations of this type underpin the power network serving the emirate's largest industrial and logistics cluster, which hosts thousands of companies.

## Project Overview

- Category: Infrastructure & Utilities
- Location: Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Dugas (JAFZA North) 132/11 kV Substation was delivered under Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) contract CE409B/2005 in the northern part of the Jebel Ali Free Zone. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the substation for EEE, working to DEWA's engineering requirements as consultant. The project forms part of MENASCO's portfolio of DEWA substation projects across Dubai.
